title: Energy Vault Breaks Ground on Powered AI Infrastructure Campus in Snyder, Texas to Deploy Crusoe Spark Modular Data Centers
summary: Energy Vault is launching an AI infrastructure campus in Texas to deploy modular data centers, enhancing sustainable energy solutions.
body_markdown: *Initial 8MW deployment of Crusoe Spark™ modular data centers, expandable to 25 MW and targeted for commercial operation in Q1 2027, demonstrating Energy Vault's "speed-to-power" AI energy infrastructure execution*
